domain-information: As a farmer, I want to plan my crop varieties in my harvest calendar before the season starts, so that I can meet member expectations.
As a member, I want to sign up for a weekly produce box, so that I can receive fresh, local vegetables regularly.
As a farmer, I want to share my expected harvest calendar, so that members know what to expect each month.
As a delivery coordinator, I want to assign pick-up points to members, so that distribution runs efficiently.
As a delivery coordinator, I want to assign a delivery driver to a delivery.
As a delivery driver, I want to deliver the produce boxes to the correct pick-up points.
As a farmer, I want to track how many boxes are needed each week, so that I can harvest the right amount of produce.
As a member, I want to see which farms contributed to my box, so that I can learn more about the growers.
As a farm cooperative manager, I want to calculate fair payouts to farmers based on box contributions, so that all partners are compensated fairly.
As a member, I want to provide feedback about box contents, so that the cooperative can adjust future harvests.
As a farmer, I want to notify members when weather affects crops, so that expectations remain realistic.
As a new member, I want to read about seasonal produce varieties, so that I can plan my meals accordingly.
As a coordinator, I want to maintain a list of local partners like bakeries or dairies, so that boxes can include add-on products.
As a member, I want to choose optional add-ons like eggs or bread for my box, so that I can customize my weekly share.
As a farmer, I want to share stories from the farm, so that members feel connected to the growing process.
As a coordinator, I want to organize volunteer harvest days, so that members can experience farm life firsthand.
As a farmer, I want to record soil and crop health data, so that I can improve yields each season.
As a member, I want to renew my subscription automatically at the end of the season, so that I don’t lose my spot.
As a farm cooperative, I want to manage seasonal membership limits, so that supply matches capacity.
As a coordinator, I want to summarize weekly distribution reports, so that farmers and members have transparency about the CSA’s operations.
